svg.text: GitGalaxy Structural Extraction: Tri-Comparison vs. Tree-sitter and ctags

No tool is ground truth. Found-count panels are unranked raw counts (no badge) -- a shared "how many are real" denominator turned out as corruptible as any one tool's own noise. Precision is each tool's own claims vs. what another tool corroborated.
Bar groups vary 1-3 by language's tool coverage -- order is always GitGalaxy, tree-sitter, ctags. css/html class panels are out of scope by design (selectors, not OOP classes).

`*` marks EVERY tool's label in a cell with any unvalidated disagreement, not just GitGalaxy's -- not a verdict either way. Badge = the tool that scored strictly highest on a RANKED, UN-disputed panel (blank on a tie, a disputed cell, or a found-count panel).
See docs/self_scan/how_to_investigate_a_discrepancy.md for what `*` is asking for.
** = validated by human/LLM inspection in lieu of another function-finding tool
Args Found markers -- † = program-level signature, not per-function · ‡ = no parameter-list concept exists for this language · § = derived from a non-parenthetical proxy, not a parameter list
Summary -- best tool per (language, metric), ranked panels only (Func/Class Precision), 73 real comparisons (1-bar groups and empty panels don't count)
Ranked-panel labels are matched/total; found-count panels are a single raw count, no denominator. Regenerate: tri_comparison_chart.py --all --write
